statements.notes: Harness the true power of creatine with Creatine A5X!

Creatine has long been established as an effective supplement for enhancing performance. With more than 600 studies supporting the efficacy, safety, and value of creatine as a performance-based supplement, it should be a part of everyone's training program!

Newer research suggests that specific forms of creatine have been reported to absorb more effectively and more rapidly improving loading time, enhancing recovery, and increasing muscle energy while decreasing bloating and GI issues.

Creatine A5X includes five scientifically selected forms of creatine to help maximize results including:
1) Creatine-magnesium chelate (Creatine MagnaPower)
2) Di-creatine malate
3) Creatine alpha-amino-N-butyrate
4) Creatine anhydrous
5) Creatine monohydrate (MonoCre)
The formula is further amplified with both betaine anhydrous and agmatine sulfate.

iSatori has engineered Creatine A5X to maximize absorption and deliver efficacious dosing to help promote muscular development, strength, enhance recovery, and delay fatigue, so you can push out more reps and sets in every workout.

To maximize your results used Creatine A5X twice daily as listed.
AM Training - 1 scoop with training - 1 scoop 6-10 hours after training
PM Training - 1 scoop 6-10 hours prior to training - 1 scoop with training

Dietary Supplement

Directions For Use: As a Dietary Supplement, adults take one serving (one scoop) of Creatine A5X one to two times per day with liquid. One serving should be taken 30-60 minutes before or after your workout. On non-training days, take one serving in the morning or the evening. This is an unflavored powder that can be mixed with any liquid such as water or any pre- or post-workout supplement. For best results, use daily for at least eight weeks and drink 8-10 glasses of water per day for general health. To be used as part of a resistance training program.
Warning: Keep out of reach of children.
